# SA-02m

This board is an SA-02m automation server. Its machine API is off until an
operator enables it on the panel card «API для ИИ-агентов».

- REST: /api/v1/ (header X-SA02M-Token, or Authorization: Bearer)
- OpenAPI: /api/v1/openapi.json
- MCP Streamable HTTP: /mcp
- Human guide: docs/AI_AGENT_INTEGRATION.md (connect, scopes, jobs, recipes)
- Contract: docs/contracts/agent-api.md
- On-board text: MCP resource sa02m://guide

Scopes: read, control, config, admin. Root commands need the token flag
root_capable. A token cannot mint another token. Irreversible operations
need confirm equal to the operation name. Start with dry_run.

GitHub OTA renders the nginx site (port and root taken from the live file).
The runner already on the board builds that manifest, so /api/v1 stays a 404
until the update after the one that delivered this runner. Until then, refresh
the site file (offline package or install.sh --refresh).
